item.name: Agony
entries: Utilized in countless tortures and slow executions, the hooked chains of this brutal weapon still smell of dried blood and rot. You gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls made with this magic weapon.
When you hit with an attack using this weapon, and that creature was injured with this weapon on your previous attack, you deal an additional {@dice 1d6} piercing damage.

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|awakens} Agony, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: The bonus to damage rolls is increased to +3.
The damage bonus to striking a creature you have already injured increases to {@dice 1d8}.
When a creature is damaged by this weapon, they suffer disadvantage on Strength ability checks until the beginning of your next turn.
When you drop a creature to 0 hit points with an attack using Agony, you can immediately make an additional melee attack with this weapon as a bonus action.

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|exalts} Agony, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: The bonus to damage rolls is increased to +4.
The damage bonus to striking a creature you have already injured increases to {@dice 2d6}.

When you score a critical hit with this weapon, the target must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you for 1 minute. If this saving throw is successful, not only does the target not become {@condition frightened}, they become immune to this frightening effect for the next 24 hours.

item.name: Armor of the Valiant Soul
entries: This antique armor forged from jade and black dragon scales was once owned and worn by J'mon Sa Ord of Ank'Harel. You have a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor.
You can cast the {@spell command} spell (save DC 13) while attuned to this armor. You cannot use this ability again until you have completed a long rest.

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|awakens} Armor of the Valiant Soul, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: Increase the bonus to AC to +2.
You gain resistance to acid damage while wearing this armor.
You gain immunity to the {@condition frightened} condition while wearing this armor.

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|exalts} Armor of the Valiant Soul, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: Increase the bonus to AC to +3.
You gain immunity to acid damage while you are wearing this armor.
Your immunity to the {@condition frightened} condition extends to include all friendly creatures within 15 feet, as long as you are conscious.
The spell save DC of the armor's {@spell command} spell becomes DC 17, and it can target four additional creatures.

item.name: Cabal's Ruin
entries: This cloak of dark leather and gold trim seems to occasionally shimmer with small sparks of blue energy across the shadowed lining. This cloak has 4 charges, and regains {@dice 1d4} expended charges daily at dawn.

When you are targeted by an enemy's spell, you can use your reaction to have the cloak swallow part of the spell. The cloak gains a number of charges equal to the spell level of the triggering spell. You are still subject to whatever effects the spell would normally inflict on you. You cannot use this ability again until you finish a short or long rest.

When you hit with an attack, you can choose to expend any number of charges from the cloak, dealing an additional {@dice 1d6} lightning damage per charge expended, which is inflicted on the target of that attack. If your attack strikes multiple targets, you must choose one target from the group to be subject to this damage.

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|awakens} Cabal's Ruin, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: You gain advantage on all saving throws against spells and other magical effects while wearing this cloak.
The cloak's maximum charges becomes 6, and it regains {@dice 1d4+2} charges daily at dawn.
When using the cloak's ability to swallow a spell, you gain resistance to the damage of that spell.

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|exalts} Cabal's Ruin, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: The cloak's maximum charges becomes 10, and it regains {@dice 1d6+4} charges daily at dawn.

item.name: Circlet of Barbed Vision
entries: Upon wearing this circlet of gnarled onyx, black barbs dig into your head, imparting power as it twists your appearance to amuse the Spider Queen. While wearing this circlet, your Charisma score decreases by 2. You also have advantage on initiative rolls.

When you make an attack roll, you can use your reaction to gain a +5 bonus to the roll. You make this choice after you see the roll, but before the DM says whether the attack hits or misses. You cannot use this ability again until you finish a short or long rest.

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|awakens} Circlet of Barbed Vision, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: You also gain resistance to poison damage, and gain immunity to the {@condition poisoned} condition.
Your ability to gain a bonus to an attack roll can be used twice between rests.

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|exalts} Circlet of Barbed Vision, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: You gain immunity to poison damage in addition to the {@condition poisoned} condition.
You can also see invisible creatures and objects.
Your ability to gain a bonus to an attack roll can be used three times between rests.

item.name: Condemner
entries: This shadow-touched hand crossbow once served as the weapon of choice for the legendary assassin Todora. You have a +1 bonus to attack rolls made with this weapon. When you hit with an attack using this weapon, the target takes an additional {@dice 1d4} poison damage.

If you hit with an attack using this weapon, instead of dealing damage, you can choose one of two effects to trigger: A {@spell fog cloud} spell centered on the target, or a {@spell silence} spell centered on the target. You can use each effect once, and cannot use them again until you finish a short rest.

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|awakens} Condemner, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: Increase the bonus to attack rolls to a +2.
Increase the poison damage inflicted on a hit to {@condition 1d6} poison damage.
You gain an additional effect that can be triggered in place of damage: the target can be affected by a {@spell hold person} spell (spell save DC 15).

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|exalts} Condemner, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: Increase the bonus to attack rolls to a +3.
Increase the poison damage inflicted on a hit to {@dice 1d8} poison damage.
The spell save DC for the {@spell hold person} spell increases to DC 17.
You gain an additional effect that can be triggered in place of damage: the {@spell blight} spell (spell save DC 17).

item.name: Deathwalker's Ward
entries: This beautiful, black leather armor is covered in intricate scrollwork, the mantle bearing the black feathers of the Matron of Ravens. You gain a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor. You have advantage on death saving throws made while wearing this armor.

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|awakens} Deathwalker's Ward, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: Increase the bonus to AC to +2.

While wearing this attuned armor, the wearer chooses and imbues this armor with resistance to a damage type of your choice: fire, cold, acid, lightning, or necrotic. This choice can be changed during a short rest.

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|exalts} Deathwalker's Ward, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: Increase the bonus to AC to +3.
As a bonus action, you can grow large, black raven wings. These last for 1 hour, and grant a fly speed of 60 feet. You cannot use this ability again until you finish a long rest.

item.name: Dynamite
entries: {@dice 4d6} fire damage to all creatures and objects in 20 foot radius (DC 12 Dexterity save for half), detonates at the start of the thrower's next turn after 6-second fuse.

item.name: Fenthras
entries: This gorgeous longbow made of everbark from the Feywild seems to flex and shift like a living entity. You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon.

When firing an arrow from this weapon, you can declare an oracle shot, allowing you to project your sight through the arrow you fire for up to 10 minutes. You cannot use this ability again until you finish a short rest.
When a creature is killed by an arrow from this weapon, a single 6-ft tree rapidly grows out of their corpse over the next minute.

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|awakens} Fenthras, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: Increase the bonus to attack and damage rolls to a +2. Additionally when you hit with an attack using this weapon, the target takes an additional {@dice 1d4} lightning damage.

When you hit with an attack, you can declare a bramble shot. The target takes an additional {@dice 3d8} piercing damage, and they must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw or become {@condition restrained} by the suddenly sprouting steel-hard thorn brambles that immediately grow from the arrow. The restrained target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. You cannot use this ability again until you finish a short or long rest.

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|exalts} Fenthras, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: Increase the bonus to attack and damage rolls to a +3.
The lightning damage dealt by attacks with this weapon increases to {@dice 1d6}.
You can use your bramble shot ability twice between rests, and the saving throw DC increases to 17.

item.name: Glue bomb
entries: Creatures within 20 foot radius must make a DC 12 Strength or Dexterity saving throw (target's choice) or be {@condition restrained}. A creature may make another DC 12 Strength check as an action to escape.

item.name: Graz'tchar, the Decadent End
entries: This blade appears to be a beautiful cruciform sword of shining silver, inlaid with sparkling rubies.
You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has the following properties.

entries.name: Corrosive Submission
entries: When you hit a humanoid with this weapon, you may force it to take an additional {@dice 3d6} acid damage and it must make a DC 14 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the creature is {@condition charmed} by you for up to 1 hour. If you attack the creature again while charmed, the acid damage increases to {@dice 10d6} and the charm ends. It cannot be charmed again for 24 hours after the charm is ended in this way.

entries.name: Hidden Nature
entries: The acid damage dealt by this greatsword appears to be radiant damage; Any creature who is successfully {@condition charmed} by it is under the illusion that the damage to it was merely an admonishing jostle. A {@spell true seeing} spell or similar reveals that this sword is actually a rusted, pitted blade dripping with acid.

entries.name: Sentience
entries: Graz'tchar is a sentient evil weapon with an Intelligence of 14, a Wisdom of 12, and a Charisma of 18. It has hearing and darkvision out to a range of 120 feet. The weapon can speak, read, and understand Common, and can communicate with its wielder telepathically. Those who hold it hear the wise voice of a sorrowful king, beckoning the user to seize their destiny.

entries.name: Personality
entries: Graz'tchar slowly attempts to sway the character into sowing chaos in Tal'Dorei, telling lies about great leaders, claiming that the heads of the Tal'Dorei Council are corrupt and must be overthrown. The voice of this blade is actually the Demon Prince of Indulgence, speaking from his Abyssal prison. Should the wielder continue to disobey the urges of the weapon for an extended period of time, it can attempt to charm the wielder. They must make a Charisma saving throw (DC 14). On a success, they are immune to the sword's charm for 24 hours. Upon a failure, they become {@condition charmed} by the sword for 24 hours. During this time, the sword can force the character to take an action of its choice once an hour, the wielder accepting this action as their own will. Should the chosen action lead to the harm of a non-hostile creature or ally, the charm immediately breaks.

item.name: Honor's Last Stand
entries: This massive, silvered shield bearing the crest of the Platinum Dragon never tarnishes. The metal is warm to the touch. While holding the shield, you have a +1 bonus to AC. This bonus is in addition to the shield's normal bonus to AC. You are also immune to the {@condition prone} condition while bearing this shield.

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|awakens} Honor's Last Stand, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: Increase the bonus to AC to +2.
Whenever a creature's attack against you misses, you can use your reaction to immediately attempt to make a shove attack against that creature.

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|exalts} Honor's Last Stand, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: Increase the bonus to AC to +3.
Using a bonus action, you can protect an adjacent ally, imparting +3 to their AC until the beginning of your next turn, or they are no longer adjacent to you (whichever comes first).

item.name: Kiss of the Changebringer
entries: A beautiful, glittering emerald is set within the center of this silver chain, humming with power and possibility. While wearing this amulet, you gain a +1 bonus to all saving throws, and are immune to the {@condition grappled} condition.

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|awakens} Kiss of the Changebringer, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: Increase the bonus to all saving throws to a +2.
You become immune to the {@condition restrained} condition as well as the {@condition grappled} condition.
You may use an action to cast the spell {@spell blink} on yourself without needing any components. You cannot use this ability again until you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|exalts} Kiss of the Changebringer, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: Increase the bonus to all saving throws to a +3.
You become immune to the {@condition paralyzed} and {@condition petrified} conditions , as well as the {@condition restrained} and {@condition grappled} conditions.

Whenever you make an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can choose to roll an additional d20. You can choose to do this after you roll the die, but before the outcome is determined. You choose which of the d20s is used for the attack roll, ability check, or saving throws. You cannot use this ability again until you finish a short or long rest.

item.name: Mythcarver
entries: This incredible silvered blade once belonged to the White Duke himself, and many more master bards before him. It resonates with nearby musical tones. You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon.
Whenever you use your {@class bard|phb|Bardic Inspiration|College of Lore|phb|bardic inspiration 1} feature, you gain advantage on attacks with this weapon until the end of your turn.

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|awakens} Mythcarver, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: Increase the bonus to attack and damage rolls to +2. In addition, targets damaged with this weapon take an additional {@dice 1d6} points of force damage.
Whenever you use your {@class bard|phb|Cutting Words|College of Lore|phb|bard college 3} feature while wielding this blade, the target has disadvantage on their next saving throw.

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|exalts} Mythcarver, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: Increase the bonus to attack and damage rolls to +3.

You can spend an action to let the spirit of the sword overtake you momentarily. You make four melee attacks with this sword, then suffer one point of exhaustion. You cannot use this ability again until you finish a long rest.

item.name: Oloore Root
entries: Oloore Root began as a druidic ceremonial tool for vision quests and communion with nature, but has become sought after by high society for its psychedelic properties. Drinking of the tea brewed from the root leads to heavy hallucinations, and sometimes grants insight to the world around them.

The imbiber must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 14) or become {@condition poisoned} for 1d4 hours. Upon a success, the imbiber gains advantage on any Wisdom ability checks for 1 hour. On a saving throw of 19 or 20, the imbiber gains supernatural distance seeing, as though they had cast a {@spell scrying} spell. They may Concentrate on this for up to 1 minute.

item.name: Plate of the Dawnmartyr
entries: Beautiful silver scrolling and priceless, cut rubies adorn this set of brass-and-gold armor. Worn by the High Priest Duana of the Dawnfather as she fell in the Battle of Ghor Dranas.
You gain a +1 bonus to AC while wearing this armor. When you are struck by a melee attack, you may use your reaction to cause the attacker to suffer {@dice 1d6} points of fire damage.

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|awakens} Plate of the Dawnmartyr, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: Increase the bonus to AC to +2.
You gain immunity to the {@condition frightened} condition.
You gain resistance to fire damage.
The damage inflicted on an attacker by the armor increases to {@dice 2d6} fire damage.

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|exalts} Plate of the Dawnmartyr, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: Increase the bonus to AC to +3.

If you are knocked {@condition unconscious} by an attack or spell, a blast of healing flame surrounds you. You immediately regain 1 hit point and are lifted to your feet. All enemy creatures within 10 feet of you suffer {@dice 2d6} fire damage. You cannot use this ability again until you finish a long rest.

item.name: Pyremaul
entries: Forged from deep red iron, this massive hammer houses an ever-burning gemstone of orange flame. You have a +1 bonus to attack rolls made with this weapon. When you hit with an attack using this weapon, the target takes an additional {@dice 1d6} fire damage.

You can choose to have this weapon shed bright light in a 30 foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. If you kill a creature with an attack using this weapon, the corpse is immolated, turning to ash.

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|awakens} Pyremaul, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: Increase the bonus to attack rolls to a +2.
Increase the additional fire damage inflicted by a hit to {@dice 2d6}.

As an action, you can slam the Pyremaul into the ground to cast the {@spell burning hands} spell at 2nd level (spell save DC 15). You cannot use this ability again until you finish a short or long rest.
When you score a critical hit with this weapon, the target must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|exalts} Pyremaul, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: Increase the bonus to attack and damage rolls to +3.
Increase the additional fire damage inflicted by a hit to {@dice 3d6}.
Your {@spell burning hands} ability is now cast at 3rd level, and the spell save DC increases to 17.

When you score a critical hit with this weapon, the target must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}. You can also roll an additional {@dice 3d6} fire damage when determining the extra damage for the critical hit.

item.name: Skysail
entries: These bat-like wings affixed to a pole are constructed out of either bone and leather or wood and cloth. While these wings are opened and the rung of the pole stepped into, you can use an action to cast {@spell levitate} on yourself at will.

Additionally, you can use an action to cast {@spell fly} on yourself for up to 1 minute (no concentration required). The fly spell ends if you lose physical contact with the skysail. You cannot use this ability again until you complete a long rest, or you (and the Skysail) are immersed in extremely powerful air elemental magic, such as the top of the Summit Peaks near the Rift of Air in Zephrah, or within the Elemental Plane of Air. When not in use, these wings can be easily folded together and worn beneath a cloak, and the pole used as a {@item quarterstaff|phb}.

item.name: Skyship
entries: {@b Personal Travel Cost:} 2 gp per mile per passenger
{@b Shipping Cost:} 1 gp per 100 lbs per mile

Within the Cloudtop district lies the Skyport, a thin tower that climbs along the surrounding wall onto a massive platform that acts as a raised harbor for docking skyships. These beautiful airships range in size, but generally are built to a similar scale as a coaster merchant ship. Skyships are held aloft and guided via the levitating power of three or more enchanted crystals called brumestones installed along the hull or topside of the ship.

The enchantments required to produce and maintain these brumestones is a very closely guarded secret by the Alsfarin Union within the distant city of Ank'Harel, and while the Alsfarin Union does occasionally sell skyships to foreign businesses, they retain absolute control over the maintenance of and number of skyships in operation. Reserved for goods and individuals who require expedient travel without the hassles of sea-faring dangers, the cost to utilizea skyship is prohibitively expensive for the common  man, leading to a sense of elitism in those who oftenmake use of their services. Due to the exclusivity of skyports within major metropolises, few skyships in service will deviate from dedicated shipping routes between major cities.

item.name: Spire of Conflux
entries: A powerful relic passed down from generation to generation of Ashari leaders. The staff has 8 charges and regains {@dice 1d4+2} expended charges daily at dawn. While holding the staff, you can expend some of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC and spellcasting ability: {@spell burning hands} (1 charge), {@spell fireball} (3 charges).

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|awakens} Spire of Conflux, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: The staff's charges increase to a maximum of 12, and it regains {@dice 1d6+2} charges at dawn daily.
Add the following spells to the list of spells the staff may be used to cast: {@spell ice storm} (4 charges), {@spell conjure elemental} (5 charges).
Whenever you cast a spell that deals fire, ice, or lightning damage and you roll a 1 on a damage die, you can reroll the die and must use the new result.

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|exalts} Spire of Conflux, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: The staff's charges increase to a maximum of 20, and it regains {@dice 1d6+4} charges at dawn daily.
Add the following spells to the list of spells the staff may be used to cast: {@spell chain lightning} (6 charges), {@spell fire storm} (7 charges).
While holding this staff, you gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls, and your spell save DC increases by 1.

item.name: Stink bomb
entries: Creatures within 20 foot radius must make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be {@condition poisoned} for {@dice 1d6} rounds, detonates after 6-second fuse.

item.name: Suude
entries: Suude is a dangerous, granular substance refined from magic residuum. Initially developed during the Age of Arcanum by archmages as an incense burned to enhance long spell ritual casting, the secret was discovered and spread among the spellcasting riffraff of Exandria. The varying forms of refinement are dangerous, and can produce one of three different types of suude.

When burned and the fumes inhaled (requiring an action), the imbiber must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 10) or become {@condition unconscious} for {@dice 2d4} rounds. With a success, the user gains 1 Sorcery Point and access to one Metamagic option (as per the Sorcerer class Font of Magic and Metamagic features) for 1 hour based on the type of suude used. If more than one dose of suude is used within 1 hour of another, the DC of the Constitution saving throw is increased by 3 per additional dose. If three or more doses are used within 1 hour of each other, failing the Constitution saving throw drops the user to 0 hit points. Brown suude grants the Extended Spell option, Blue suude grants the Twinned Spell option, and Red suude grants the Distant Spell option.

item.name: Titanstone Knuckles
entries: Carved from the heartstone of a ruined earth primordial, these gauntlets bestow immeasurable might to the wearer. Your Strength score becomes 22.
{@i Siege.} You deal double damage against objects and structures.

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|awakens} Titanstone Knuckles, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: Your Strength score becomes 24.
You can use an action to grow in size as per the {@spell Enlarge/Reduce|pbb|enlarge} spell for 10 minutes. You cannot use this ability again until you finish a long rest.

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|exalts} Titanstone Knuckles, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: Your Strength score becomes 26.

While you are under the effects of the {@spell Enlarge/Reduce|pbb|enlarge} spell granted by this item, you gain resistance to fire, cold, and lightning damage. This lasts as long as you are affected by the spell.

item.name: Whisper
entries: Forged with a mercurial metal pulled from the Far Realm, light dances and shifts across this curved blade. You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this weapon.

Whenever you strike a creature with a critical hit using Whisper, the target must make a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} of you for 1 minute. On a success, they are immune to being frightened by this effect for the next 24 hours.

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|awakens} Whisper, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: Increase the bonus to attack and damage to a +2. Additionally, when you hit a target with this weapon, the target takes an additional {@dice 1d6} psychic damage.
Increase the DC to resist being {@condition frightened} from a critical hit to 15.

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|exalts} Whisper, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: Increase the bonus to attack and damage to a +3, and increase the additional damage taken to {@dice 1d8} psychic damage.
Increase the DC to resist being {@condition frightened} from a critical hit to 17.

Whenever Whisper is thrown but before it hits, you can choose to transform into shadow and merge with the blade, teleporting instantly to wherever the blade impacts. If the target is a creature, you emerge adjacent to the target in a space of your choice. If you miss with the attack, the DM determines where you teleport accordingly.

item.name: Wind glider
entries: Requires 1 minute to harness. While harnessed and falling, the bearer falls at 30 feet per round, and the wind glider carries the bearer 40 feet in a line each round until they land. You can change direction each round. While harnessed, your movement is halved, and you have disadvantage on attack rolls. A wind glider has an AC of 10, and 5 hit points.

item.name: Wraps of Dyamak
entries: Created and wielded by the ancient warrior called Dyamak, these thick cloth strips of enchanted material appear to be stained with blood of unknown origin. You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with your unarmed strikes.
Whenever you finish a short or long rest, you gain a number of temporary hit points equal to your full ki points.

entries.name: Awakened
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|awakens} Wraps of Dyamak, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: Increase your bonus to attack and damage rolls to +2.
As a bonus action, you can cast the spell {@spell misty step}. You cannot use this ability again until you score a critical hit with an unarmed strike, or you complete a short or long rest.

entries.name: Exalted
entries: When a character {@variantrule The Advancement of a Vestige|TalDorei|exalts} Wraps of Dyamak, apply the following changes to the item's traits:

items: Increase your bonus to attack and damage rolls to +3.

When you hit with an unarmed strike, you can choose to make the attack a Ravenous Strike. The target takes an additional {@dice 6d6} necrotic damage, and you regain hit points equal to the additional necrotic damage dealt. You cannot use this ability again until you complete a short or long rest.

item.name: Zeal
entries: Zeal is distilled from the blood of captured or slain {@creature quaggoth} deep from beneath the surface of Exandria. When brewed properly, a thick, purple-colored liquid that tastes of ash remains.

Drinking zeal or applying liberally to exposed skin (requiring an action) forces the user to make a Constitution saving throw (DC 12) or become {@condition paralyzed} for {@dice 1d4} rounds as every muscle seizes up. With a success, the user deals an additional 3 damage to any target it hits with a melee attack for {@dice 2d6} rounds. The user suffers 1 point of {@condition exhaustion} after the effect ends, regardless of saving throw success.
